look.why: A rich Congo-basin forest emerald green that frames the charcoal-black coat and silverback saddle.

size.measure: standing height about 1.6–1.75 m for an adult silverback (1.4–1.8 m per ADW)

habitat.text: Lowland tropical rainforests and swamp forests across Central Africa.

diet.text: Leaves, stems, shoots, pith, wild fruits, bamboo and termites—consuming up to 18 kg of vegetation daily.

facts.text: The largest living primate; adult males develop a saddle of silver-white hair across their backs around age 12.
A silverback's chest-beat echoes over 1 km through dense jungle and honestly signals his body size to rivals.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis dataran rendah dan hutan rawa di Afrika bagian tengah.
id.diet: Daun, batang, tunas, empulur, buah-buahan liar, bambu, dan rayap—memakan hingga 18 kg tumbuhan setiap hari.
facts: Primata terbesar yang masih hidup; jantan dewasa menumbuhkan bulu perak di punggungnya (silverback) sekitar usia 12 tahun.
Tepukan dada pejantan silverback menggema lebih dari 1 km menembus hutan lebat sebagai sinyal ukuran tubuhnya.
